slug: 2026-01-01 Burundi's growing social protection system now runs on openIMIS

facts.fact: openIMIS states that since May 2025 the CORE-MIS solution powered by openIMIS has managed cash transfers and income-generating-activity financing for 1.25 million Merankabandi beneficiaries across five provinces, after over 1 million records were migrated from the legacy system.
openIMIS states that Burundi's multiple payment providers are integrated with the Merankabandi system for automated payments and reconciliation.

systems.owner: Government of Burundi, World Bank-financed Merankabandi

note: Describes payments by mobile phone to refugees but names no programme information system.

facts.fact: Merankabandi II coordinator Michel Nyabenda said a modernised management information system (MIS) has been deployed in the Burundian government's data centre, while enrolment of 249,671 households in the Registre social unique continues.

systems.owner: Merankabandi II, Government of Burundi data centre

facts.fact: The World Bank states that investments in an open-source management information system (CORE-MIS) have established the foundations of Burundi's national social protection system, supporting the Merankabandi programme nationwide.
The World Bank states that investments in CORE-MIS and digital payments enable delivery of Merankabandi assistance nationwide.

The World Bank states that the Unified Social Registry, CORE-MIS and digital payments are increasingly used across sectors and by other development programmes, with the registry also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar project.

claims.gtmi-63b431cdf9: nothing: a pension or social insurance system; the study assesses social assistance programmes

facts.fact: The World Bank team said in January 2026 that Merankabandi runs on CORE-MIS, an open-source management information system after migrating over one million beneficiary records, hosted by the government at SETIC, covering over 315,000 households.
The World Bank team said in January 2026 that CORE-MIS manages disbursements and is interconnected with several payment service providers for payment processing and reconciliation.
